n9.why: F2a is the temperature-dependent 2theta plot that carries all three states as colour-coded curve sets (SC blue near-linear, PC red curved and offset, HOC black), so the reader erred by seeing only two colours and never naming SC/PC/HOC, which the panel encodes by colour rather than by a written label.

n12.why: F4a and F4b are exactly the surface-to-core evidence: three excitation wavelengths give probe depths 19.6/60.6/493.7 nm over 138-148 K, and the ~785 nm (tetragonal) share rises with shallower depth, so the grader erred by demanding a structural technique when the paper's phase proxy is the PL peak ratio, an assignment already listed in the node's requires_unseen.
